notes: DRAFT. Soldiers cost 1 denarius less; +1 to battle rolls.

notes: DRAFT. Two years to build. +2 loyalty every season.

notes: DRAFT. 8 bales of fleece at the Spring shearing.

notes: DRAFT. +0.5 months of food every season; with salt, 2 jars of salted fish.

notes: DRAFT. Sea water dries in the summer sun: 10 sacks.

name: Woodcutters' camp
notes: DRAFT. 4 loads of timber a season once the paths are cut.

notes: DRAFT. 3 bars of iron a season. Two shafts at most.

notes: DRAFT. A fortress on the crag above the town, joined to the walls. +5 to every battle at home: the town can hardly be taken. Three years to build.
